items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) developed a GRADE-based clinical practice guideline for rehabilitating athletes with hamstring strain injury, synthesizing evidence from randomized clinical trials.
items.curatedReason: 这份 GRADE 评级的腘绳肌拉伤指南基于最新的 RCT 证据。它可以作为你康复决策的可靠参考，尤其是针对巴西运动员，但需注意其文化和运动背景的适用性。
items.titleZh: 运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南
items.summaryZh: 巴西国家运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了一项基于 GRADE 的临床实践指南，旨在为运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复提供支持，综合了随机临床试验的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This GRADE-based guideline for hamstring strain injury is grounded in the latest RCT evidence. It serves as a reliable reference for your rehabilitation decisions, especially for Brazilian athletes, but consider its applicability to other cultural and athletic contexts.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: A theoretical framework proposes conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process (HODA-A), rather than isolated manual techniques, and applies COSMIN principles for its evaluation.
items.curatedReason: 手法评估（HODA-A）若要达到与患者报告结果测量（PROM）相当的严谨性，就必须应用 COSMIN 原则。你应当采纳这种测量学视角，重新审视和验证自己常用的手法评估手段。
items.titleZh: 将手法肌肉骨骼评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：应用 COSMIN 到 HODA-A 的理论框架
items.summaryZh: 一项理论框架提出将肌肉骨骼手法评估概念化为一种临床报告结果测量过程 (HODA-A)，而非孤立的手法技术，并应用 COSMIN 原则对其进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hands-on assessment (HODA-A) to achieve the same rigor as patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs), it must apply COSMIN principles. You should adopt this psychometric perspective to re-evaluate and validate the manual assessment techniques you commonly use.
items.limitation: 这是一篇理论性文章，尚无实证数据支持其提出的评估序列和框架。
items.limitationEn: This is a theoretical paper without empirical data to support its proposed assessment sequence and framework.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients found that thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF, all p < 0.001) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP, p < 0.001) compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴联合常规康复能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能和吸气肌力量，尤其在优化通气力学方面有优势。这提示你可以将胸部肌内效贴作为呼吸神经康复的实用辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的随机对照试验发现，胸部肌内效贴联合常规康复显著改善了肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF，均 p < 0.001）和吸气肌力量（MIP，p < 0.001），优于安慰剂贴扎。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia, particularly in optimizing ventilatory mechanics. This suggests you can consider thoracic KT as a practical adjunct in respiratory neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本单中心 RCT（30 名患者），且随访期较短，对长期效果的推断需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-center RCT (30 patients) with a short follow-up period, so long-term effects should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 81 cervicogenic headache patients found that both kinesio taping and myofascial release, combined with home exercise, effectively reduced pain and improved quality of life, with MFR showing more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life at one-month follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，肌内效贴 (KT) 和肌筋膜松解 (MFR) 联合家庭锻炼均能有效改善颈源性头痛。其中，MFR 在残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善，这表明 MFR 可能是颈源性头痛更优的长期康复策略。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴与肌筋膜松解疗法在颈源性头痛中的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 81 名颈源性头痛患者的随机对照试验发现，肌内效贴和肌筋膜松解疗法联合家庭锻炼均能有效减轻疼痛并改善生活质量，其中肌筋膜松解在为期一个月的随访中在残疾和身体生活质量方面显示出更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that both Kinesio Taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR), combined with home exercise, are effective for cervicogenic headache. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life, indicating it may be a superior long-term rehabilitation strategy for cervicogenic headache.
items.limitation: 随访期较短（1 个月），无法评估长期疗效；研究人群来自单一中心，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period was short (1 month), precluding assessment of long-term efficacy; the study population came from a single center, which may affect generalizability.

items.title: How does pre-stroke physical activity influence physical activity one year after minor stroke, and what role does cognitive impairment play?
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 100 minor stroke patients found that low pre-stroke physical activity was associated with 5.81 times higher odds of low physical activity 12 months post-stroke (95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p = 0.010), while the role of cognitive impairment remained inconclusive.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中前活动量低的患者在卒中 12 个月后更有可能持续不活跃（OR = 5.81）。将卒中前活动量纳入评估，有助于识别高风险患者并指导个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 卒中前身体活动如何影响轻度卒中后一年身体活动，以及认知障碍扮演何种角色？
items.summaryZh: 一项对 100 名轻度卒中患者的二次分析发现，卒中前身体活动水平较低的患者在卒中 12 个月后身体活动水平较低的几率高 5.81 倍（95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p = 0.010），而认知障碍的调节作用尚无定论。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that patients with low pre-stroke physical activity are significantly more likely to remain inactive 12 months post-stroke (OR = 5.81). Incorporating pre-stroke activity levels into your assessment can help identify high-risk patients and guide personalized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（100 名），且认知障碍的调节作用不确定性较高（95% CI: 0.81-89.9）。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (100 patients), and the modifying role of cognitive impairment showed high uncertainty (95% CI: 0.81-89.9).

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: A pilot study of "Let's Move," an early exercise program for hospitalized patients, found good adherence (76.5%) and safety among 26 participants, with 96.2% achieving individualized goals, supporting its feasibility and need for broader evaluation.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”是一个早期活动计划的初步探索，结果提示该计划在住院患者中具有可行性与安全性，依从性达 76.5%，96.2% 的参与者实现目标。虽然样本量仅为 26 人，但你可以借鉴其初步成果，考虑在你所在住院部启动更大型的早期活动项目。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计
items.summaryZh: 一项针对住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的试点研究发现，26 名参与者的依从性良好（76.5%）且安全，96.2% 的参与者实现了个体化目标，支持了其可行性并需进行更广泛的评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: The “Let's Move” pilot study suggests feasibility and safety for early exercise in hospitalized patients, with 76.5% adherence and 96.2% achieving goals. Although the sample size is small (26 participants), you can use these preliminary findings to consider initiating a larger early mobility program in your inpatient setting.
items.limitation: 试点研究样本量较小（26 名），且在单中心进行，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The pilot study had a small sample size (26 participants) and was conducted at a single center, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: A study found that a submaximal graded cycling exercise test up to vigorous intensity was well tolerated by mothers and fetuses in both singleton and twin pregnancies, with few differences in acute maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，中等至高强度运动对单胎和双胎妊娠的母胎心血管反应差异不大。这为更新双胎妊娠运动指南提供了高质量证据，支持你鼓励双胎孕妇在无禁忌症下保持活跃。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中等至高强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，单胎和双胎妊娠中，母亲和胎儿对亚最大分级循环运动测试至高强度的耐受性良好，母胎急性心血管反应差异不大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found few differences in maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies. This provides high-quality evidence to inform exercise advice for twin pregnancies, supporting your recommendation for active twin pregnant women without contraindications.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且运动测试在实验室环境下进行，可能无法完全反映日常活动的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and exercise testing was conducted in a laboratory setting, which may not fully reflect the effects of daily activities.

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study of 511 athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 found that 62% returned to sport at preinjury levels within 24 months post-primary ACL-R, with an average duration of 12.3 months (SD 4.7).
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性、基于注册的队列研究发现，ACL-R 术后高活跃运动员（Tegner ≥ 7）24 个月内重返运动（Tegner ≥ 7）的比例为 62%，平均需 12.3 个月。这为你制定术后康复计划和设定患者期望提供了现实数据。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后运动员重返运动：一项基于全国注册的纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 511 名术前 Tegner 活动量表 ≥ 7 分的运动员进行的全国性、基于注册的纵向队列研究发现，62% 的运动员在初次 ACL 重建术后 24 个月内恢复到术前运动水平，平均持续时间为 12.3 个月（SD 4.7）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study found that 62% of highly active athletes (Tegner ≥ 7) returned to sport (Tegner ≥ 7) within 24 months after primary ACL-R, with an average duration of 12.3 months. This provides realistic data for your post-operative rehabilitation planning and setting patient expectations.
items.limitation: 研究依靠患者自报数据和注册信息，可能存在回忆偏倚和数据完整性问题。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on patient-reported data and registry information, which may be subject to recall bias and data completeness issues.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes revealed pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations, leading to inconsistent guidance and heightened uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后阶段面临的独特挑战，包括教练和医疗服务提供者的知识不足。这提醒你，在为残疾运动员提供孕产期支持时，需要更专业的知识和适应性方案。
items.titleZh: 精英残疾运动员妊娠和产后经历的考察：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索精英残疾运动员妊娠和产后经历的定性研究揭示了教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织之间普遍存在的残疾特异性知识空白，导致指导不一致和不确定性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the unique challenges elite Para athletes face during pregnancy and postpartum, including knowledge gaps among coaches and healthcare providers. This underscores the need for more specialized knowledge and adaptive protocols when providing maternity support to Para athletes.
items.limitation: 定性研究样本量较小，结论的普遍性有限，且结果基于受访者的主观体验。
items.limitationEn: The qualitative study had a small sample size, limiting generalizability, and results were based on subjective experiences of interviewees.

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 12% of studies progressed to a definitive RCT, primarily due to lack of funding.
items.curatedReason: 中风康复领域，前瞻性试验的报告质量仍有待提高，并且仅有 12% 的可行性研究能进展到最终的随机对照试验。这提示你在评估新干预的前期证据时，要对研究设计和报告的质量保持警惕。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复领域的试点和可行性研究：报告质量、进展到试验的情况以及障碍：一项范围界定综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 项卒中康复领域试点和可行性研究的范围界定综述发现，报告质量平均为 6.1/11 分，且仅有 12% 的研究进展到明确的 RCT，主要原因是资金不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: In stroke rehabilitation, the reporting quality of pilot and feasibility studies needs improvement, with only 12% progressing to definitive RCTs. This indicates you should be cautious when evaluating early evidence for new interventions, paying close attention to study design and reporting quality.
items.limitation: 综述方法可能未覆盖所有相关的试点和可行性研究，特别是那些未发表或非英文的研究。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review methodology might not have covered all relevant pilot and feasibility studies, especially unpublished or non-English ones.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: The Georges Gymnastics Program, an inclusive school-based service for children with intellectual disability, partnered with an Olympic training center to scale its offerings, demonstrating a model for improving physical activity and fundamental movement skills.
items.curatedReason: Georges 体操项目通过与奥运训练中心合作，成功将针对智力障碍儿童的学校体操服务扩大规模。这展示了针对特定发育障碍儿童的包容性体育活动的可行模式和潜在益处，可作为社区康复项目的参考。
items.titleZh: Georges 体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作扩大针对智力障碍儿童的包容性校本体操服务
items.summaryZh: Georges 体操项目是一项针对智力障碍儿童的包容性校本服务，通过与奥运训练中心合作扩大了服务范围，展示了改善身体活动和基本运动技能的模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Georges Gymnastics Program successfully scaled an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training center partnership. This demonstrates a feasible model and potential benefits of inclusive sports activities for children with specific developmental disabilities, serving as a reference for community rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究主要描述项目设计和初步实施，缺乏对照组和长期疗效评估数据。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily describes program design and initial implementation, lacking control group and long-term efficacy evaluation data.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: A commentary highlights endometriosis as a striking blind spot in elite sports research, noting its chronic pain and fatigue symptoms may affect female athletes' training, performance, and quality of life, underscoring the need for more dedicated studies.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论指出，子宫内膜异位症在精英运动员研究中是一个显著的盲点，其症状可能影响训练和表现。它提醒你关注女性运动员中这种被忽视的慢性病，并倡导更多相关研究和支持。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究盲点
items.summaryZh: 一篇评论文章指出子宫内膜异位症是精英运动研究中的一个显著盲点，其慢性疼痛和疲劳症状可能影响女性运动员的训练、表现和生活质量，强调需要更多专门研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights endometriosis as a striking blind spot in elite athlete research, whose symptoms can impact training and performance. It urges you to pay attention to this overlooked chronic condition in female athletes and advocates for more related research and support.
items.limitation: 这是一篇评论性文章，不提供新的研究数据或临床证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary piece and does not provide new research data or clinical evidence.

items.title: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summary: A preliminary validation study of the Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) in 78 patients with voice disorders demonstrated emerging content, construct, concurrent, and predictive validity, supporting its use for increased clarity in stimulability testing documentation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究初步验证了用于声音障碍患者多维刺激性测试评定量表（MSP-V）的有效性，为言语病理学家提供了更精细的评估工具。对物理治疗师来说，这提示了在其他康复领域开发类似多维评估工具的潜力。
items.titleZh: 声音障碍患者多维刺激性测试评定量表的初步验证
items.summaryZh: 一项对 78 名声音障碍患者进行的多维刺激性声音档案（MSP-V）评定量表的初步验证研究表明，该量表具有内容、结构、并发和预测效度，支持其在刺激性测试记录中提供更高清晰度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers preliminary validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) rating scale for patients with voice disorders, providing speech-language pathologists with a more refined assessment tool. For physical therapists, this suggests the potential for developing similar multidimensional assessment tools in other rehabilitation fields.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅是初步验证，需要进一步在不同人群中进行大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size and provided only preliminary validation, requiring further large-scale validation in diverse populations.

items.title: Feasibility and Measurement Properties of a Large Language Model-Based Virtual Patient Laboratory for Clinical Reasoning Training in Physical Therapy Students: Single-Arm Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with 27 physical therapy students found a large language model-based virtual patient lab feasible for clinical reasoning training, but LLM-generated clinical judgment ratings clustered near the maximum and did not reflect human assessor ratings with a real patient.
items.curatedReason: 本研究发现，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的虚拟患者实验室在物理治疗学生临床推理训练中的可行性良好，但 LLM 生成的评分与人类评估的真实患者表现相关性不强。这提示你在使用 AI 工具进行教学和评估时，要警惕其评分的有效性，仍需人类专家校准。
items.titleZh: 基于大型语言模型的虚拟患者实验室在物理治疗学生临床推理训练中的可行性与测量特性：单臂试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 27 名物理治疗学生的试点研究发现，基于大型语言模型的虚拟患者实验室在临床推理训练中是可行的，但 LLM 生成的临床判断评分集中在最高分附近，且未能反映人类评估者对真实患者的评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that a large language model (LLM)-based virtual patient lab was feasible for clinical reasoning training in physical therapy students, but LLM-generated ratings did not strongly correlate with human assessments of real patient performance. This cautions you to be wary of the validity of AI-generated scores when using AI tools for teaching and assessment, still requiring human expert calibration.
items.limitation: 研究发现 LLM 生成的评分普遍偏高且与真实患者表现的相关性不足，限制了其作为评估工具的有效性。
items.limitationEn: The study found that LLM-generated ratings were generally high and showed insufficient correlation with real patient performance, limiting their effectiveness as an assessment tool.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review found no clear association between reduced spinal ROM and outcomes for various spinal pain conditions, with consistently very low certainty of evidence and high risk of bias across studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述表明，在各种脊柱疼痛病症中，脊柱活动度（ROM）受限并非预测疼痛强度、功能障碍或康复情况的明确因素。现有证据的确定性极低，且所有纳入研究均存在高偏倚风险，因此不应将ROM受限作为唯一的预后指标。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度下降是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和总体恢复的预测因素吗？一项系统评价
items.titleEn: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统评价发现，对于各种脊柱疼痛患者，脊柱活动度下降与疼痛强度、残疾或恢复之间没有明确的关联，所有研究的证据确定性都非常低，且偏倚风险很高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that reduced spinal range of motion (ROM) is not a clear prognostic factor for pain intensity, disability, or recovery in various spinal pain conditions. The evidence certainty was consistently very low across all included studies, all of which had a high risk of bias.
items.limitation: 所有 37 项研究均存在高偏倚风险，证据确定性一致非常低。
items.limitationEn: All 37 included studies were rated as having a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was consistently very low.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review using shear wave elastography found reduced vastus medialis stiffness post-ACLR associated with function and reduced semitendinosus stiffness post-hamstring harvest, emphasizing the need for standardized protocols.
items.curatedReason: 这项利用剪切波弹性成像（SWE）的系统综述显示，ACL重建术后股内侧肌的僵硬度降低与力量和功能相关；同时，腘绳肌腱取后，半腱肌的僵硬度也随之降低。这提示我们，未来需要标准化的SWE协议来指导临床评估和干预。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度：一项系统评价
items.titleEn: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summaryZh: 一项使用剪切波弹性成像的系统评价发现，前交叉韧带重建术后股内侧肌僵硬度降低与功能相关，腘绳肌腱取样后半腱肌僵硬度降低，强调了标准化方案的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review using shear wave elastography (SWE) shows reduced vastus medialis stiffness post-ACLR, correlating with strength and function. It also identified reduced semitendinosus stiffness after hamstring harvest. Standardized protocols are needed for clinical application.
items.limitation: 无研究对股内侧斜肌远端或腘绳肌远端肌腱区域进行采样，且主动收缩的纵向研究结果存在冲突。
items.limitationEn: No study sampled the distal vastus medialis obliquus or distal hamstring musculotendinous region, and longitudinal data on active contraction findings were conflicted.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and depressive symptoms compared to usual care in this RCT.
items.curatedReason: 6个月的线上康复训练（Pilates+筋膜放松）显著改善了纤维肌痛患者的症状和睡眠，别再依赖线下常规治疗了。
items.titleZh: 结合普拉提治疗性锻炼和自我筋膜松解术的六个月监督远程康复治疗对纤维肌痛症患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六个月的监督性远程康复项目，结合了普拉提为基础的锻炼和自我筋膜松解术，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的影响、睡眠质量和心理结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care.
items.limitation: 未评估 6 个月以上远期疗效，焦虑结果未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: Long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed, and anxiety outcomes did not show significant improvement.

items.title: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summary: This study found dysphagia in frail older adults is linked to decreased physical performance (SPPB) and increased fall risk, highlighting the need for routine swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究发现，虚弱老年人的吞咽困难与身体机能下降（SPPB 评分较低）和跌倒风险增加显著相关。这意味着在老年病护理中，常规进行吞咽评估至关重要，不应忽视吞咽功能对整体健康和安全的影响。
items.titleZh: 吞咽困难与衰弱老年人身体机能及跌倒风险的关联
items.titleEn: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，衰弱老年人的吞咽困难与其较差的身体机能（SPPB 评分降低）和较高的跌倒风险显著相关，强调了在老年护理中进行吞咽评估的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that dysphagia in frail older adults is significantly associated with poorer physical performance (lower SPPB scores) and increased fall risk, underscoring the importance of swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性研究，样本量相对较小（109 例）。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with a relatively small sample size (109 patients).

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review found very low certainty evidence for dextrose prolotherapy in chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy/bursitis, with potential for little to no benefit compared to saline and worse performance than corticosteroids, highlighting the need for high-quality RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性肩袖肌腱病/滑囊炎，这项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，葡萄糖增生疗法的证据确定性极低，它与生理盐水相比可能几乎没有益处，且与皮质类固醇注射相比，运动表现可能更差。目前急需高质量的随机对照试验（RCT）来验证其临床价值。
items.titleZh: 注射用糊精治疗慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.titleEn: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统评价发现，注射用糊精治疗慢性肩袖肌腱病/滑囊炎的证据确定性极低，与生理盐水相比益处甚微或无益，与皮质类固醇注射相比可能导致体能表现下降，凸显了高质量RCT的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis found very low certainty evidence for dextrose prolotherapy in rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis. It may offer little to no benefit compared to saline and potentially worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections. High-quality RCTs are needed.
items.limitation: 证据确定性极低，多数研究偏倚风险高，且规模小、随访期短。
items.limitationEn: The evidence certainty was very low, with most included studies having a high risk of bias and being small and short-term.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In knee osteoarthritis, this RCT found MI-RT superior for quadriceps strength, while passive BFR at 70% LOP improved functional ability more than MI-RT with less exertion, presenting a feasible alternative.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎，本 RCT 发现中等强度抗阻训练（MI-RT）对股四头肌力量最有效。但被动血流限制训练（BFR）在 70% LOP 下，以更小的感知劳累度，在功能改善方面优于 MI-RT，这意味着 BFR 是 MI-RT 不耐受患者的一个可行替代方案。
items.titleZh: 不同负荷下的血流限制与中等强度抗阻训练对膝关节骨关节炎患者的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，在中度强度抗阻训练（MI-RT）对膝关节骨关节炎患者股四头肌力量最有效的情况下，70% LOP 的被动血流限制（BFR）在较低的感知劳累度下改善了下肢功能能力，使其成为无法耐受 MI-RT 患者的可行选择。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT) most effective for quadriceps strength in knee osteoarthritis, while passive BFR at 70% LOP yielded greater improvements in functional ability with less perceived exertion, making it a feasible option for those who can't tolerate MI-RT.
items.limitation: 50% LOP 的被动 BFR 相比其他干预措施，功能改善较小。
items.limitationEn: Passive BFR at 50% LOP showed smaller functional improvements than the other interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review debunks the heel-strike fallacy and the universal 180 steps/min cadence belief in running, emphasizing individualized adjustments based on specific goals.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述批驳了跑步中“脚跟着地有害”的误解和“每分钟 180 步是普适步频”的信条，强调跑步姿势和步频应根据个体目标进行调整。这意味着我们不应盲目遵循普遍建议，而应根据患者具体情况和目标来指导跑步训练。
items.titleZh: 后足触地谬误与跑者步频信念：一项叙述性综述
items.titleEn: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述挑战了长跑中常见的信念，指出后足触地并非固有危害，180步/分钟并非普遍最优步频，且改变应基于个体目标而非普遍性标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review challenges common beliefs in distance running, stating that rearfoot striking is not inherently harmful, 180 steps/min is not universally optimal cadence, and that changes should be based on individual goals rather than generalized targets.
items.limitation: 本文为叙述性综述，不呈现新的实证数据；建议基于现有文献综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review and does not present new empirical data; recommendations are based on synthesizing existing literature.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed approach to prioritize exercise for frail older adults, matching interventions to dominant physiological limitations like weakness, breathlessness, or instability.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于指导虚弱老年人的运动优先级。它建议针对虚弱主要采用抗阻训练，针对呼吸困难主要采用有氧训练，针对步态不稳主要采用平衡训练，并将多成分运动作为默认选择。这意味着你应根据患者最主要的生理限制来制定个性化运动方案。
items.titleZh: 衰弱症的运动优先化：针对老年人康复的病理生理学知识整合型叙述性综述
items.titleEn: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述为衰弱老年人运动优先化提供了一个基于病理生理学知识的框架，建议针对虚弱进行抗阻训练，针对气短进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练，并以多组分运动作为默认选项。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review provides a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercises in frail older adults, suggesting resistance training for weakness, aerobic for breathlessness, and balance for gait instability, with multicomponent exercise as the default.
items.limitation: 仍需在衰弱人群中进行直接试验，以测试此优先处方模型。
items.limitationEn: Direct trials specifically in frailty-defined populations testing this prioritized prescription model are still needed.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: This podcast explores AI's impact on physical therapy practice and payment, discussing its potential to reduce administrative tasks and improve patient care time.
items.curatedReason: AI 的影响已不限于理论，它正在实实在在地改变物理治疗的实践和支付模式。听完这期，你会明白 AI 如何减轻行政负担、优化工作流程，并最终让你有更多时间投入到患者护理中，这才是真正的价值所在。
items.titleZh: 探索人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响
items.titleEn: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summaryZh: 这期播客探讨了人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响，重点介绍了其在减轻行政负担、改进工作流程和增加患者护理时间方面的潜力，并汇集了行业领导者的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This podcast episode discusses how AI is impacting physical therapist practice and payment, focusing on reducing administrative burden, improving workflows, and enhancing patient care time, with insights from industry leaders.
items.limitation: 本期播客讨论了应用和误解，而非实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a podcast episode discussing applications and misconceptions, not empirical research.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summary: Physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district report significant barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders, including inadequate training and resources, leading to infrequent patient care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 地区的物理治疗师在处理盆底疾病（PFD）时面临的严重障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅。这意味着该地区患者很少能得到有效的 PFD 管理，凸显了资源和培训的迫切需求。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底障碍的经验
items.titleEn: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 区的物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFDs）方面面临重大障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅，导致患者管理频率低下。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district face significant barriers in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs), including limited undergraduate training, understaffing, and poor referral pathways, resulting in infrequent patient management.
items.limitation: 研究集中于南非特定地区，限制了其推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on a specific district in South Africa, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 63 sources mapped relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation, primarily in multiple sclerosis and stroke. Interventions were feasible and well-accepted, with outcomes mainly assessed for psychological functioning at the body structure/function level, highlighting gaps in less prevalent conditions and activity/participation outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 放松干预在神经康复中应用广泛，但在多发性硬化和卒中之外的其他疾病、以及生理应激、活动和参与等结局方面，证据仍有较大空白。评估放松干预时，请注意其主要效果仍集中在心理功能层面。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中放松干预的范围界定综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖63篇文献的范围界定综述梳理了神经康复中的放松干预，主要集中于多发性硬化和卒中患者。干预措施可行且接受度高，但主要在身体结构和功能层面评估心理功能结局，提示在不常见疾病和活动/参与结局方面存在研究空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: While relaxation interventions are widely used in neurological rehabilitation, significant evidence gaps remain for conditions beyond MS and stroke, as well as for outcomes beyond psychological functioning, such as physiological stress, activity, and participation. When evaluating relaxation interventions, note that their primary effects are still concentrated on psychological function.
items.limitation: 本综述识别出证据异质性高、缺乏比较有效性研究和定性设计等局限。
items.limitationEn: This review identified limitations including high evidence heterogeneity, lack of comparative effectiveness studies, and qualitative designs.
