items.title: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summary: Directional EMG mapping revealed that severe stroke survivors have disrupted upper-limb force control with direction-specific deficits and compensatory strategies correlated with impairment severity.
items.curatedReason: 利用定向肌电图（EMG）标测技术，本研究发现重度中风幸存者上肢力量控制存在紊乱，表现为方向特异性缺陷和补偿策略，且这些与损伤严重程度相关。这意味着评估上肢功能时，需要考虑这些方向性障碍及其对日常活动的影响。
items.titleZh: 方向性肌电图模式揭示了卒中后上肢力控制中与损伤相关的中断
items.titleEn: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summaryZh: 一项使用方向性肌电图绘制的研究发现，严重受损的卒中幸存者表现出上肢力控制中断，其方向特异性缺陷和代偿策略与损伤严重程度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study using directional EMG mapping found that stroke survivors with severe impairment exhibit disrupted upper-limb force control, with direction-specific deficits and compensatory strategies that correlate with impairment severity.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（仅 8 名慢性卒中幸存者），且为回顾性注册。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (8 chronic stroke survivors) and was retrospectively registered.

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review found limited evidence on WBV and LSE for postural control in flexible flatfoot, with most data from related populations and a call for RCTs specifically in FF.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查发现，在柔韧性扁平足（FF）患者中，全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定运动（LSE）对姿势控制的证据有限，现有数据多来自相关人群。这意味着在 FF 人群中，我们急需设计良好的随机对照试验（RCT）来验证这些干预措施的有效性。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰椎稳定练习对姿势控制的证据映射：一项针对弹性平足的范围审查
items.titleEn: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summaryZh: 这项范围审查发现，关于全身振动（WBV）和腰椎稳定练习（LSE）对弹性平足（FF）姿势控制的研究证据有限，大部分证据来自相关人群，并且迫切需要针对 FF 人群设计良好的 RCT。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found limited evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF), with most evidence from related populations and a need for well-designed RCTs in the FF population.
items.limitation: 在 FF 中仅识别出两项直接干预研究，均未评估 WBV 或 LSE，因此有效性仍不确定。
items.limitationEn: Only two direct intervention studies in FF were identified, neither evaluating WBV or LSE, thus effectiveness remains uncertain.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) combined with conventional physical therapy led to significantly greater improvements in upper-limb motor function (ARAT scores increased by 12.05 and 12.44 points respectively, P < .001) compared to conventional physical therapy alone in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者的手功能恢复，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电图引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 都比单纯常规物理治疗效果更好，但两者之间没有显著差异。在设计手功能康复方案时，不必纠结于这两种电刺激技术的选择，可优先考虑患者依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中手功能恢复疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，结合常规物理治疗的感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）均能显著改善上肢运动功能（ARAT 评分分别增加 12.05 和 12.44 分，P < .001），效果优于单独的常规物理治疗，但 SES 与 Alt-EMG 之间没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hand function recovery in chronic stroke patients, both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) are superior to conventional physical therapy alone, but there is no significant difference between the two. When designing hand rehabilitation programs, focus on patient adherence and equipment availability rather than overthinking the choice between these two electrical stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 60 人，随访期为 12 周，可能限制了长期效应和在不同卒中阶段的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 60 participants with a 12-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and applicability across different stroke stages.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis (27 studies, 1177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) in healthy adults (g = 0.49, p = 0.001), but had smaller, non-significant effects in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065), with higher BMI associated with smaller intervention effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析明确指出，慢性运动训练能改善健康成年人的步行代谢成本，但在卒中患者中效果较小，且肥胖可能削弱这种益处。在为患者制定运动方案时，应考虑这些群体特异性，对卒中患者设置更实际的步行经济性改善预期，并同时关注体重管理。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本影响的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析（27 项研究，1177 名参与者）发现，慢性身体运动训练改善了健康成年人的步行代谢成本（g = 0.40，p = 0.001），其中健康个体效果显著（g = 0.49，p = 0.001），但在卒中患者中效果较小且不显著（g = 0.24，p = 0.065），较高的 BMI 与较小的干预效果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis clearly indicates that chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults, with smaller effects in stroke patients, and obesity may diminish this benefit. When designing exercise programs, consider these population-specific factors, set more realistic expectations for improved walking economy in stroke patients, and simultaneously focus on weight management.
items.limitation: 尽管包含了 27 项研究，但神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小，尤其是多发性硬化和帕金森病患者仅各一项研究，限制了对这些群体结果的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Despite including 27 studies, the sample size for neurological conditions was relatively small, with only one study each for multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease, limiting the certainty of results for these groups.

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study of 14 women explored patient experiences with physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction in Sweden, finding that it served as a "complementary piece of a puzzle" by enabling equity and improving accessibility, but also highlighting concerns about the absence of physical examination and hands-on guidance.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复是产后盆底功能障碍的有效补充模式，能提升可及性和依从性。但远程模式仍有局限性，例如无法进行体格检查和手把手指导。考虑采用混合模式，将远程和线下诊疗结合，以提供更个性化的康复服务。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍物理治疗远程康复患者体验的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对 14 名瑞典女性进行的定性研究探讨了产后盆底功能障碍患者的物理治疗远程康复体验。研究发现远程康复是“一块补充性拼图”，能提高公平性和可及性，但也凸显了患者对缺乏体格检查和手把手指导的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation is an effective complementary model for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, improving accessibility and adherence. However, the remote format still has limitations, such as the inability to perform physical examinations and hands-on guidance. Consider a hybrid model combining remote and in-person care to provide more personalized rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（14 名参与者），结果的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (14 participants), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: This process evaluation, using semi-structured interviews and a focus group with 13 patients and 4 physiotherapists, found that the Enhanced Rehabilitation after Major Trauma Programme (ERP) for survivors of the Manchester Arena bombing was viewed as a valuable, structured, multidisciplinary approach, but raised concerns about sustaining progress and transitioning back to standard NHS care.
items.curatedReason: 针对重大创伤患者，结构化、多学科康复方案（如曼彻斯特爆炸案后的 ERP）显著优于标准 NHS 康复。但注意长期康复的可持续性与资源限制。在临床实践中，可借鉴其多学科协作和个性化设计理念，但要为患者后续转介和支持做好规划。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案严重肌肉骨骼损伤患者强化康复项目的过程评估：调查患者和物理治疗师的经验
items.summaryZh: 这项对曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案幸存者的强化康复项目（ERP）进行的过程评估，通过与 13 名患者和 4 名物理治疗师的半结构化访谈和焦点小组讨论发现，ERP 被视为有价值的、结构化的多学科方法，但也引发了对其进展可持续性和回归标准 NHS 护理的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: For major trauma patients, structured, multidisciplinary rehabilitation programs like ERP (from the Manchester Arena bombing) are significantly better than standard NHS rehabilitation. Be mindful of long-term sustainability and resource constraints. In practice, adopt its multidisciplinary collaboration and personalized design principles, but plan for patient referrals and ongoing support.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（13 名患者和 4 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (13 patients and 4 physiotherapists), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.

items.title: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summary: This observational cohort study (N=1683) found that post-stroke patients with a first EHR-documented aggression (18.8%) had a 2.83/1000 patient-day incidence, 8.1% 30-day and 15.6% 60-day risks, longer LOS (+17.9 days), and poorer mFIM outcomes compared to nonaggressive patients, suggesting a 60-day precaution window for planning.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后首次出现攻击行为是一个重要的规划信号，提示患者在 60 天内发生其他不良事件（如跌倒、尿路感染）的风险较高，且住院时间更长、功能预后更差。在评估和制定康复计划时，应将此作为危险信号，调整目标设置和出院日期预期，并加强风险管理。
items.titleZh: 首次攻击行为作为卒中急性期后康复的规划信号：来自综合观察队列的服务基准、目标设定和 60 天预防窗口
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性队列研究（N=1683）发现，卒中后首次出现电子健康记录记载的攻击行为的患者（18.8%）发生率为 2.83/1000 患者日，30 天和 60 天风险分别为 8.1% 和 15.6%，且与无攻击行为患者相比，住院时间更长（+17.9 天），运动功能独立性评定（mFIM）结果更差，提示在规划时应设置 60 天预防窗口。
items.curatedReasonEn: The first aggressive behavior after stroke is an important planning signal, indicating a higher risk of other adverse events (e.g., falls, UTIs) within 60 days, longer hospital stays, and poorer functional outcomes. Integrate this into your assessment and rehabilitation planning as a red flag, adjusting goal setting and discharge date expectations, and enhancing risk management.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性队列研究，尽管进行了倾向匹配，但仍无法完全排除混杂因素，且是单中心数据，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational cohort study, despite propensity matching, cannot fully exclude confounders and is based on single-center data, potentially limiting generalizability.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes (cognition, mood, anxiety, fatigue) through three reviews at 1, 3, and 6 months, showing potential to address gaps in UK post-stroke care.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后轻中度认知、情绪、焦虑和疲劳改变的患者提供了监测和自我管理支持，可作为英国卒中社区护理的补充。这提示我们可以关注此类患者的心理变化，并考虑将类似简短干预整合到常规康复路径中，尤其在资源有限的社区环境中。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目的开发：一项复杂干预，旨在匹配护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目是一项旨在通过在 1、3 和 6 个月进行三次评估，监测和支持卒中后心理变化（认知、情绪、焦虑、疲劳）自我管理的简短干预措施，有望弥补英国卒中后护理的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers monitoring and self-management support for post-stroke patients with mild-to-moderate cognitive, mood, anxiety, and fatigue changes, complementing UK stroke community care. This suggests focusing on such psychological changes in patients and integrating similar brief interventions into standard rehabilitation pathways, especially in resource-limited community settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项复杂干预措施的设计和开发报告，尚未进行临床有效性测试，其效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This is a report on the design and development of a complex intervention, with clinical effectiveness testing still planned, so its impact is not yet clear.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review highlights shifts in ACL reconstruction toward quadriceps tendon autografts and lateral augmentation for high-risk knees. It emphasizes that return-to-play decisions should be criteria-based, combining time from surgery, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, given that limb symmetry index may overestimate recovery and psychological readiness independently impacts re-injury risk.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的康复和重返运动评估，已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估。未来 ACLR 患者的重返运动方案，应结合手术时间、功能标准和心理准备度进行综合判断。特别注意患者心理准备度对重返运动和二次损伤风险的独立影响。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、外侧增强、康复和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 本综述重点介绍了前交叉韧带重建术向股四头肌腱自体移植和高危膝关节外侧增强的转变。它强调重返运动的决定应基于标准，结合术后时间、功能标准和心理准备，因为肢体对称指数可能高估恢复程度，且心理准备独立影响再次受伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-ACLR rehabilitation and return-to-play assessment have shifted from fixed timelines to criteria-based evaluation. Future return-to-play protocols for ACLR patients should integrate surgical time, functional criteria, and psychological readiness. Pay particular attention to the independent impact of psychological readiness on return-to-sport and second injury risk.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，信息整合可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏系统的证据评估方法。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, and information synthesis may be subject to selection bias, lacking systematic evidence evaluation methods.

items.title: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study in Japan found that the provision of weekend rehabilitation services was significantly associated with early rehabilitation initiation (incidence rate ratio 1.65) in 17,194 acute ischemic stroke patients, while therapist staffing levels and stroke volume were not.
items.curatedReason: 这项日本研究显示，急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复的启动率主要受医院层面的系统性因素影响，特别是周末康复服务的提供。如果你希望提高早期康复启动率，应考虑优化排班和资源配置以支持周末服务。
items.titleZh: 医院层面因素与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动的关联：一项日本农村县行政数据库的多水平分析
items.summaryZh: 一项在日本进行的多中心横断面研究发现，提供周末康复服务与 17,194 名急性缺血性卒中患者的早期康复启动显著相关（发生率比 1.65），而治疗师人员配备和卒中量则无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Japanese study indicates that early rehabilitation initiation for acute ischemic stroke patients is largely influenced by hospital-level systemic factors, especially the provision of weekend rehabilitation services. If you aim to improve early rehabilitation initiation rates, consider optimizing scheduling and resource allocation to support weekend services.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，未能确立因果关系，且数据来自日本一个农村县的行政数据库，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and its reliance on an administrative database from a rural Japanese prefecture limits generalizability.

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial posits telerehabilitation as a necessary evolution for musculoskeletal physical therapy, not as a replacement for traditional care but as a means to extend the therapist's role through continuous monitoring, communication, education, and patient engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，远程康复不是面对面治疗的替代品，而是物理治疗师通过连续监测、沟通和患者教育来延伸其角色的方式，认识到这能拓展你的服务边界。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必然演进
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评认为远程康复是肌肉骨骼物理治疗的必然演进，它不是传统治疗的替代，而是通过连续监测、沟通、教育和患者参与来拓展治疗师角色的方式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that telerehabilitation isn't a replacement for in-person therapy but rather an extension of the physical therapist's role through continuous monitoring, communication, and patient education. Recognize how this can expand your service reach.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 16,783 participants with traumatic spinal cord injury found that lower time-updated social integration scores (HR 1.09) and within-person declines (HR 1.077) were associated with higher subsequent all-cause mortality, observed across natural and external causes.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，较低的社会融合度及其下降趋势与更高的死亡风险相关。在康复计划中，要警惕社会融合度的变化，这能作为预后信息的参考点，但目前证据不足以指导你直接干预社会融合来改变生存率。
items.titleZh: 时间变化性社会融合与创伤性脊髓损伤后长期全因和特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16,783 名创伤性脊髓损伤患者的纵向研究发现，较低的社会融合度（HR 1.09）和个体内下降（HR 1.077）与随后的全因死亡率升高相关，涵盖自然和外部原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with traumatic spinal cord injury, lower and declining social integration scores are associated with higher mortality risk. Be aware of changes in social integration as a prognostic indicator within rehabilitation programs, but the current evidence is insufficient to guide direct interventions on social integration to alter survival rates.
items.limitation: 研究未明确建立社会融合度干预与生存率改善的因果关系，且存在幸存者选择偏差和部分死亡原因数据缺失。
items.limitationEn: The study did not establish a causal link between social integration interventions and improved survival, and limitations include survivor selection bias and missing cause-of-death data.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study

items.title: Engagement strategies to support sub-acute, post-stroke upper limb interventions: A co-design study.
items.summary: A four-stage co-design study with 30 knowledge-users (stroke survivors, clinicians, scientists) identified 13 engagement themes and synthesized 10 clinician-delivered strategies to support stroke survivor engagement during sub-acute, face-to-face upper limb rehabilitation. Personalization via timing and emphasis was identified as a governing principle.
items.curatedReason: 这份有 30 名知识使用者参与的共同设计研究，提出了 10 种提升亚急性期卒中患者上肢康复参与度的策略，并强调个性化。这些策略尚待 RCT 验证其有效性，但在临床实践中可作为启发思路的参考。
items.titleZh: 共同设计研究：支持亚急性期卒中上肢康复干预参与度的策略
items.summaryZh: 一项四阶段共同设计研究，纳入 30 名知识使用者（卒中幸存者 9 名、临床医生 11 名、科研人员 10 名），确定了 13 个参与度主题，并综合形成了 10 种由临床医生实施的策略，以支持卒中患者在亚急性期面对面上肢康复期间的参与度。研究将通过时机和侧重实现的个性化定位为指导各项参与策略的核心原则。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study identified 10 strategies to support engagement in post-stroke upper limb rehabilitation, emphasizing personalization. Be mindful that clinical feasibility still needs testing before widespread implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性共同设计研究，未进行干预实施或临床效果验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative co-design study, without intervention delivery or clinical outcome validation.

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonographic Median Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Wheelchair Users With Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: In a cross-sectional study of 67 wheelchair users with SCI (126 wrists), ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) showed moderate diagnostic accuracy (AuROC 0.76) for carpal tunnel syndrome. A 10 mm² cutoff provided 90.5% sensitivity and 45.2% specificity, while 15 mm² yielded 33.3% sensitivity and 91.7% specificity.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤的轮椅使用者，超声正中神经横截面积（CSA-M）是腕管综合征中度准确的诊断工具。在临床实践中，您可以根据筛查和诊断的不同目的，灵活选择 10 mm² 或 15 mm² 作为截止值。
items.titleZh: 超声正中神经横截面积诊断脊髓损伤轮椅使用者腕管综合征的性能研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 67 名脊髓损伤轮椅使用者（126 只手腕）的横断面研究显示，超声正中神经横截面积（CSA-M）诊断腕管综合征的准确性中等（AuROC 0.76）。10 mm² 的截止值敏感性为 90.5%，特异性为 45.2%；而 15 mm² 的截止值敏感性为 33.3%，特异性为 91.7%。
items.curatedReasonEn: For wheelchair users with SCI, ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) offers moderate diagnostic accuracy for carpal tunnel syndrome. In practice, you can choose 10 mm² (high sensitivity) or 15 mm² (high specificity) cutoffs based on whether you're screening or confirming diagnosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、横断面研究，可能存在选择偏倚，且不同截止值下的诊断性能有取舍。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, cross-sectional study, potentially subject to selection bias, and diagnostic performance varied with different cutoffs.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 22 physiotherapists found interest in technology for sensorimotor assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury. Physiotherapists called for measurable indicators of movement quality but noted that technology adoption was limited by uncertainty regarding clinical value and integration with clinical reasoning.
items.curatedReason: PT 们普遍认为需要更客观的运动质量指标，并乐意将技术作为临床评估和院外康复的补充。在 ACL 康复中引进新技术的关键在于技术开发者要能清晰展示其临床价值，并将其无缝集成到 PT 现有的临床工作流中。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师对 ACL 损伤后感觉运动控制及技术应用前景的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 22 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，他们对 ACL 损伤后感觉运动控制的评估和康复技术应用表示兴趣。物理治疗师呼吁更可测量的运动质量指标，但技术的采纳受限于对其临床价值的不确定性以及与临床推理的整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: PTs recognize the need for objective movement quality metrics and are open to technology as a complement to clinical assessment and remote rehab. For ACL rehab, technology adoption hinges on clear demonstration of clinical value and seamless integration into existing PT workflows.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（22 名物理治疗师），结果不具普遍代表性。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size (22 physiotherapists), and the findings may not be broadly representative.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summary: A survey of 183 German surgeons found high variability and limited evidence in recommendations for return to sport after lumbar disc herniation surgery. A separate patient survey (n=106) reported an average return to sport at 12.1 ± 11.7 weeks, restoring preoperative performance after 15.2 weeks, generally later than recommended by surgeons.
items.curatedReason: 这份调查揭示了腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的指导缺乏证据且医生间差异大。患者实际重返运动时间比建议的更晚。将这些信息纳入您的术后宣教，管理患者的现实预期。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动：德国外科医生调查与患者术后体验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 183 名德国外科医生的调查显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的建议存在显著差异且证据有限。一项独立的患者调查（n=106）报告平均在术后 12.1 ± 11.7 周重返运动，并在 15.2 周后恢复术前水平，通常晚于外科医生的建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey highlights the variability and lack of evidence for return-to-sport guidelines after lumbar disc herniation surgery. Patients actually return later than recommended. Incorporate this information into your post-operative education to manage patient expectations.
items.limitation: 本研究为两项独立调查数据的对比分析，非直接可比队列，且患者数据来自单中心，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study compared two independent survey datasets, which are not directly comparable, and patient data was from a single center, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A 12-week RCT (n=71) in cardiac rehabilitation patients found short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3×9 RT) resistance training similarly increased VO₂peak (+3.6 vs. +4.0 ml/kg/min; P=0.786) and total lean mass (+1.04 vs. +0.94 kg; P=0.791). 3/7 RT significantly improved isokinetic quadriceps strength more than 3×9 RT (+23 vs. +11 N·m; P=0.022), but no consistent superiority was observed across all strength measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对于心血管疾病患者，短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3×9 RT）抗阻训练在心肺康复中均可行且有效。两种方案在最大耗氧量和精瘦体质量方面无显著差异，但短休息方案对股四头肌等速力量提升更明显。选择方案时可优先考虑患者偏好。
items.titleZh: 短休息间歇与传统多组抗阻训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 12 周的随机临床试验（n=71）发现，在心脏康复患者中，短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3×9 RT）抗阻训练均能类似地提高最大耗氧量（+3.6 vs. +4.0 ml/kg/min; P=0.786）和总精瘦体质量（+1.04 vs. +0.94 kg; P=0.791）。3/7 RT 显著比 3×9 RT 更好地改善了股四头肌等速力量（+23 vs. +11 N·m; P=0.022），但并未在所有力量测量中显示出持续的优越性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that both short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3×9 RT) resistance training are feasible and effective in cardiac rehabilitation for cardiovascular disease patients. While VO₂peak and lean mass gains were similar, the short-rest protocol showed a more pronounced improvement in isokinetic quadriceps strength. Patient preference can guide modality selection.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间为 12 周，长期效果尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a 12-week follow-up, and long-term effects require further validation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: A prospective study of 111 first-ever stroke patients found that physical and psychosocial HRQoL showed divergent recovery trajectories over 3 months. Functional ambulation (β = 0.483, p < 0.001) was associated with physical HRQoL, while depressive symptom severity (β = -0.692, p < 0.001) was associated with mental HRQoL.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复中，身体功能（如步态）和抑郁症状对患者生活质量的改善轨迹有不同影响。制定康复计划时，除了关注身体机能，也务必及早识别并干预抑郁情绪，因为它显著影响患者心理层面的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 卒中后生活质量的早期变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对111名首次卒中患者的前瞻性研究发现，卒中后3个月内身体和心理社会层面的生活质量恢复轨迹存在差异。功能性步态（β = 0.483, p < 0.001）与身体生活质量改善相关，而抑郁症状严重程度（β = -0.692, p < 0.001）与心理生活质量改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In early post-stroke rehabilitation, physical function (e.g., ambulation) and depressive symptoms impact quality of life (HRQoL) improvement differently. When planning rehabilitation, prioritize early identification and intervention for depression, as it significantly affects mental HRQoL, in addition to physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究随访期仅为3个月，可能无法捕捉长期HRQoL的变化，且样本量较小（n=111）。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 3 months, which may not capture long-term HRQoL changes, and the sample size was relatively small (n=111).

items.title: Experiences of sexual rehabilitation post-stroke among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored sexual rehabilitation experiences among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors (n=18) and partners (n=5). Three themes emerged: sexuality addressed post-stroke, negative interactions with health professionals, and sexuality absent in rehabilitation, highlighting gaps in inclusive, effective interventions.
items.curatedReason: 针对 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者的性康复需求长期被忽视，且医疗专业人员的沟通方式和知识储备不足是主要障碍。作为物理治疗师，请在患者评估和沟通中保持包容性和非预设性，并考虑接受相关培训。
items.titleZh: LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣的卒中后性康复体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了LGBTQI+卒中幸存者（n=18）及其伴侣（n=5）的卒中后性康复体验。研究发现三个主要主题：卒中后性需求被提及、与医疗专业人员的负面互动，以及康复中性话题的缺失，凸显了包容性有效干预的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The sexual rehabilitation needs of LGBTQI+ stroke survivors have been largely neglected, with healthcare professionals' communication styles and knowledge gaps identified as major barriers. As a physical therapist, ensure inclusive and non-presumptive communication during patient assessment and consider pursuing relevant training.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（18名卒中幸存者和5名伴侣），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (18 stroke survivors and 5 partners), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 21 older adults after total knee arthroplasty identified barriers and facilitators to home-based exercise decision-making. Barriers included intuitive avoidance responses (pain, fear, preference for comfort) and external support constraints, while facilitators involved rational adherence (perceived threat, willpower, negotiation).
items.curatedReason: TKA 术后老年患者的居家康复依从性受多重因素影响。了解患者的疼痛规避、恐惧以及对舒适的偏好，并结合个体化目标设定、正面文化引导和协商策略，将有助于提升居家康复效果。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术后居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对21名老年全膝关节置换术后患者的定性研究，探讨了居家康复锻炼决策的障碍和促进因素。障碍包括本能的回避反应（疼痛、恐惧、偏爱即时舒适）和外部支持限制，而促进因素涉及理性依从（不良预后威胁感知、意志力、协商策略）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to home-based rehabilitation after TKA in older adults is influenced by multiple factors. Understanding patients' pain avoidance, fear, and preference for comfort, coupled with individualized goal setting, positive cultural framing, and negotiation strategies, will help improve the effectiveness of home rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（n=21），且在三级医院招募，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=21), recruited from tertiary hospitals, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: A narrative review synthesizing PR research from 2021-2026 highlights expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, growth in alternative delivery models, increasing evidence for economic benefits, and persistent challenges in access and long-term maintenance.
items.curatedReason: 肺康复的范围已显著拓宽，不再局限于稳定期 COPD，多种慢性呼吸系统疾病患者均可从中获益。若中心化康复不可行，可考虑提供循证的替代模式。同时，维持康复效果和经济效益的证据也在不断增加。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新进展
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了2021-2026年肺康复研究的最新进展，强调了其适用范围已从稳定期COPD扩展到多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，替代模式日益增多，经济效益证据不断累积，但普及率低和长期效果维持仍是挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) has significantly broadened its scope beyond stable COPD, benefiting patients with various chronic respiratory diseases. If center-based PR is not feasible, consider offering evidence-based alternative models. Evidence supporting sustained benefits and economic advantages of PR is also growing.

items.title: Correction
items.summary: A correction was issued for a systematic review and meta-analysis due to a data entry error in Table 3. The sample size for the 30 Hz subgroup under the FMA-UE outcome was incorrectly reported as n=184, and the correct sample size is n=192.
items.curatedReason: 这份勘误通知了此前一项关于迷走神经刺激对卒中康复影响的系统综述中，某亚组样本量数据有误。在引用该综述时，请核对修正后的数据，避免引用错误。
items.titleZh: 勘误
items.summaryZh: 《物理医学与康复档案》更正了此前发表的一篇关于迷走神经刺激对卒中康复影响的系统综述和Meta分析中的数据录入错误，其中FMA-UE结局下30 Hz亚组的样本量由n=184更正为n=192。
items.curatedReasonEn: This erratum corrects a sample size error in a previous systematic review on vagus nerve stimulation for stroke rehabilitation. When citing that review, please verify the corrected data to avoid miscitation.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=148) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4) or disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9) compared with sham PBMT in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain over 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型 RCT 明确表明，对于慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）并无额外临床益处。下次评估腰痛方案时，请将 PBMT 从常规选项中排除。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练的辅助手段，对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的疗效微乎其微：一项随机试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=148）发现，对于慢性非特异性腰痛成人，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）与假 PBMT 相比，在 12 个月内对疼痛强度（MD -0.4 分, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4）或残疾（MD -0.7 分, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9）没有临床上重要的额外改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large RCT clearly shows that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise offers no additional clinical benefit for chronic non-specific low back pain. Exclude PBMT from routine options when evaluating back pain protocols.
items.limitation: 研究排除了有特定病理或脊柱手术史的患者，结果主要适用于慢性非特异性腰痛人群。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded patients with specific pathologies or previous spinal surgery, so results primarily apply to individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain.

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 25 RCTs (n=1,540) found that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise were effective for reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders, with multimodal treatments being most effective. The combination of dry needling and manual therapy appeared to be the most effective approach.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持手法治疗和治疗性运动是颞下颌关节紊乱（TMDs）止痛的有效一线干预。当患者出现 TMDs 相关疼痛时，你应优先考虑这些非侵入性治疗手段，且干针联合手法治疗似乎是最有效的组合。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱患者疼痛方面的疗效：一项网络荟萃分析的系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项随机对照试验（n=1,540）的网络荟萃分析发现，手法治疗和治疗性运动在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱疼痛方面有效，其中多模式治疗最为有效。干针结合手法治疗似乎是最有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports manual therapy and therapeutic exercise as effective first-line interventions for pain reduction in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs). When patients present with TMDs-related pain, you should prioritize these non-invasive treatments, and dry needling combined with manual therapy appears to be the most effective combination.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量存在异质性（PEDro 评分 3-9 分），可能影响荟萃分析的整体证据强度。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality of the included studies was heterogeneous (PEDro scores ranging from 3 to 9), which may affect the overall strength of evidence in the meta-analysis.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: This qualitative study used focus groups (n=15 adolescents with LBP) to co-design pain neuroscience education (PNE) material. Findings highlighted the need for relatable, practical, engaging, and easy-to-navigate back-specific information, leading to the development of the "Back To Move" prototype.
items.curatedReason: 青少年腰痛患者需要疼痛神经科学教育（PNE），但其形式必须贴近他们的世界。共同设计出的 Back To Move 原型强调了具体、实用、可信且适合年轻人偏好的内容，这应指导你为青少年提供 PNE 的方式。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动；为青少年腰痛患者共同设计疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组的洞察。
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究通过焦点小组（n=15 名患有腰痛的青少年）共同设计疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料。研究结果强调了对与青少年相关、实用、引人入胜且易于导航的腰部特定信息的需求，从而开发了“Back To Move”原型。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adolescents with low back pain need pain neuroscience education (PNE), but it must be delivered in a way that resonates with them. The co-designed Back To Move prototype emphasizes specific, practical, trustworthy, and youth-preferred content, which should guide your approach to PNE for adolescents.
items.limitation: 本研究是焦点小组的定性研究，主要关注内容共创，未评估 PNE 干预的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study is a qualitative focus group study, primarily focusing on content co-design, and did not evaluate the clinical efficacy of PNE interventions.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=491) found that adherence to home-based exercise therapy was 45% in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain. Higher physical activity before cLBP onset, lower cLBP intensity, and lower treatment burden were associated with higher adherence, but supervision did not significantly influence it.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对慢性腰痛患者的横断面研究表明，家庭运动依从性仅有 45%，并且未能证明监督对依从性的显著影响。你的诊疗策略应更注重患者先前的活动水平、疼痛强度和治疗负担，以提升依从性。
items.titleZh: 非特异性慢性腰痛成人家庭运动疗法依从性：一项包含 491 名参与者的 ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列（ADHERE II）横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（n=491）发现，非特异性慢性腰痛成人居家运动疗法的依从性为 45%。腰痛发作前较高的身体活动水平、较低的腰痛强度和较低的治疗负担与较高的依从性相关，但监督并未显著影响依从性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study on chronic low back pain patients shows home exercise adherence is only 45% and failed to demonstrate a significant influence of supervision on adherence. Your clinical strategy should focus more on patients' prior activity levels, pain intensity, and treatment burden to improve adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立家庭运动依从性的因果关系，且依赖患者自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality for home exercise adherence and relies on self-reported data.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: This scoping review of 80 RCTs found that continuity of care interventions for stroke most often included only stroke survivors and focused on the transition from acute to home care, often neglecting family-centered approaches and other critical transitions in the care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出，中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预研究，常未能同时纳入两者，且未充分涵盖所有照护过渡阶段。你设计康复方案时，要确保覆盖急性期到居家照护之外的更多过渡，并始终以家庭为中心。
items.titleZh: 针对中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 这项对 80 项随机对照试验的范围综述发现，中风连续性照护干预最常只包括中风幸存者，并侧重于从急性期到居家照护的过渡，常忽略以家庭为中心的方法和照护连续体中其他关键过渡。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers often don't include both, and don't adequately cover all care transitions. When designing rehabilitation plans, ensure broader coverage beyond acute to home care transitions, and always adopt a family-centered approach.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，此研究综合了 RCT 的存在和类型，但未评估干预的具体疗效，也未纳入非随机研究。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study synthesized the existence and types of RCTs but did not evaluate the specific efficacy of interventions and did not include non-randomized studies.

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=11) with older adults aging into disability found multidimensional barriers to community-based fall prevention exercise programs, including lack of awareness, interconnected accessibility issues, stigma, and program misalignment, suggesting the need for co-designed, inclusive, and identity-affirming programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究显示，患有残疾的老年人在参与社区跌倒预防运动项目时面临多重障碍，包括耻辱感和项目不匹配。在推广或设计跌倒预防项目时，要考虑重新品牌化并与目标人群共同设计，以提高包容性和参与度。
items.titleZh: “这不适合我”：针对逐渐残疾的老年人的社区跌倒预防运动项目。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对逐渐残疾老年人（n=11）的定性研究发现，参与社区跌倒预防运动项目存在多重障碍，包括意识不足、相互关联的可及性问题、耻辱感和项目不匹配，这表明需要共同设计、包容和身份认同的项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study shows older adults with disabilities face multiple barriers to participating in community fall prevention exercise programs, including stigma and program misalignment. When promoting or designing fall prevention programs, consider rebranding and co-designing with the target population to improve inclusivity and participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（n=11），结果不能直接推论至更广泛人群，且是自我报告的限制和需求。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=11), so the findings cannot be directly generalized to a broader population, and it relies on self-reported limitations and needs.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) model for COPD patients was technically feasible (device data transmission agreement >99%) and clinically feasible, with high patient retention (95%), satisfaction (median 30), and usability (median 80.0), alongside increased endurance time (median difference 171.00 seconds).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，COPD 患者居家肺康复（HBPR）模型在技术和临床上均可行，设备数据传输准确，患者满意度高，并有初步的耐力改善。这支持了远程 HBPR 作为一种可行的康复模式，你可以考虑将其整合到慢性病管理中，但仍需等待更大规模的 RCT 验证疗效。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性。
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段可行性研究发现，COPD 患者的居家肺远程康复（HBPR）模型在技术上（设备数据传输一致性 >99%）和临床上均可行，具有高患者依从性（95%）、满意度（中位数 30）和可用性（中位数 80.0），同时耐力时间增加（中位数差异 171.00 秒）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates the technical and clinical feasibility of a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) model for COPD patients, showing accurate device data transmission, high patient satisfaction, and preliminary endurance improvements. This supports tele-HBPR as a viable rehabilitation mode you can integrate into chronic disease management, but awaits larger RCTs for efficacy validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，样本量小（n=20），且未设置对照组，无法评估临床疗效的确定性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a feasibility study with a small sample size (n=20) and no control group, so it cannot definitively assess clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study (n=35 post-stroke patients) introduced ScoreE, an isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric to quantify elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. ScoreE demonstrated good to excellent inter-rater (ICCs 0.81-0.89) and test-retest reliability (ICCs 0.76-0.93), showed moderate associations with MAS grades, and offers a more objective, visually interpretable assessment than MAS.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提出了 ScoreE，一个客观、可靠的工具，用于量化卒中后肘部和腕部屈肌过度抵抗。这为临床评估和纵向监测提供了比 Modified Ashworth Scale 更精确的替代方案，你可以考虑将其引入研究或高级临床评估中。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘部和腕部屈肌过度抵抗的规范扭矩曲线方法：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究（n=35 名卒中后患者）引入了 ScoreE，一个等速测力计衍生的指标，用于量化肘部和腕部屈肌过度抵抗。ScoreE 表现出良好至优秀的评估者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和测试重测可靠性（ICC 0.76-0.93），与 MAS 等级呈中度相关，并提供比 MAS 更客观、可视化的评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, an objective and reliable tool for quantifying post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. This offers a more precise alternative to the Modified Ashworth Scale for clinical assessment and longitudinal monitoring; consider incorporating it into research or advanced clinical evaluations.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小（n=35），且仅为概念验证，需要更大规模、多中心研究验证其在临床实践中的广泛应用和响应性。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size (n=35) and is only a proof-of-principle, requiring larger, multi-center studies to validate its widespread clinical application and responsiveness.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on physiotherapy for persistent pelvic pain, outlining key principles and diverse interventions tailored to individual patient needs and pain mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理提供了最新概览，强调了多模式、个体化治疗在不同表型患者中的应用前景。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述综合了当前关于持续性盆腔疼痛物理治疗的证据，概述了根据患者个体需求和疼痛机制量身定制的关键原则和多样化干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review offers an updated overview of physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain, highlighting the potential of multimodal, individualized treatment across different patient phenotypes.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that caregiver assessments inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH) after stroke. Most studies only assessed subjective financial strain or a single objective indicator, highlighting a need for multidimensional integration in future instruments.
items.curatedReason: 此范围综述揭示，现有中风照护者评估工具未能充分捕捉财务负担和非医疗健康决定因素。你的评估应整合多维度的财务毒性和 NMDOH 指标，以更全面识别脆弱性，并支持更公平、可持续的康复。
items.titleZh: 中风后财务负担、非医疗健康决定因素与早期照护角色形成：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究的范围综述发现，中风后照护者评估未能一致地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康决定因素（NMDOH）。大多数研究仅评估了主观财务压力或单一客观指标，凸显了未来工具中多维度整合的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals that current stroke caregiver assessments inadequately capture financial burden and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH). Your evaluations should integrate multidimensional financial toxicity and NMDOH measures to better identify vulnerabilities and support equitable, sustainable recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未对纳入研究的证据质量进行严格评估，且仅限于过去十年的出版物。
items.limitationEn: This study is a scoping review, which did not rigorously assess the quality of evidence of included studies and was limited to publications from the last ten years.

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This appraisal highlights a new clinical practice guideline for the physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder, providing updated evidence-based recommendations for assessment and intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这篇指南评价文章表明，发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理已有新指南发布。你应该查阅该指南原文，了解最新的循证干预措施和评估标准，以指导你的儿科实践。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 本评估重点介绍了发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理的新临床实践指南，提供了评估和干预的最新循证建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guideline appraisal indicates a new guideline has been published for the physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder. You should consult the original guideline to understand the latest evidence-based interventions and assessment criteria to guide your pediatric practice.

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series of 100 patients after quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction found that 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9; adjusted R² = 0.36; P < .03), and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI strongly predicted both Lysholm and IKDC scores (β = 3.9-4.7; adjusted R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后早期（3个月）的等长股四头肌肢体对称指数（LSI）和9个月的等速股四头肌LSI与2年患者报告结局（PROMs）显著相关。这提示您在康复早期应重视股四头肌力量恢复，并利用LSI作为指导康复和预测远期功能恢复的重要指标。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后早期肢体对称指数与2年患者报告结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对100名股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后患者的病例系列研究发现，3个月时等长股四头肌LSI强烈预测2年IKDC评分（β = 3.9; adjusted R² = 0.36; P < .03），9个月时等速股四头肌LSI强烈预测Lysholm和IKDC评分（β = 3.9-4.7; adjusted R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that early (3-month) isometric quadriceps LSI and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI are significantly associated with 2-year PROMs after QT-ACLR. This suggests you prioritize early quadriceps strength recovery and utilize LSI as a crucial metric for guiding rehabilitation and predicting long-term functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性病例系列，证据等级为4级，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在混杂因素未完全控制。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case series (Level 4 evidence), which cannot establish causality and may have unaddressed confounding factors.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=75) compared HILT+UNGE, ESWT+UNGE, and UNGE alone for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. Both HILT and ESWT improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone (all P < .001). HILT produced significantly greater improvements than ESWT across electrophysiological outcomes and DASH scores, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，高强度激光疗法（HILT）联合尺神经滑动练习（UNGE）在改善烧伤后肘管综合征的神经电生理和上肢功能方面优于体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）联合UNGE或单独UNGE。这提示您在临床上处理这类患者时，可以优先考虑HILT作为物理治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法联合尺神经滑动练习的电生理和功能反应：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名烧伤后肘管综合征患者的随机对照试验，比较了HILT+UNGE、ESWT+UNGE和单独UNGE的疗效。结果显示，HILT和ESWT均比单独UNGE更能改善神经传导和上肢功能（均P < .001）。HILT在电生理和DASH评分上均优于ESWT，且效果在12周随访时仍保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that High-Intensity Laser Therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) was superior to Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT) combined with UNGE, or UNGE alone, for improving electrophysiological and upper-limb functional outcomes in post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. This suggests you may prioritize HILT as a physical therapy option for these patients in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 随访期仅12周，长期疗效尚不明确，且研究人群为烧伤后肘管综合征，结果外推至其他病因的肘管综合征需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period was only 12 weeks, so long-term efficacy is unclear. The study population was specific to post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, limiting generalizability to other etiologies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial

items.title: Physical performance clustering as a marker of frailty, fall risk, and cognitive health in older adults
items.summary: An unsupervised classification study of 368 older adults identified three physical performance clusters (High, Moderate, Low), which differed significantly across most physical performance measures, especially muscular power and joint moments. The Low Physical Performance group included more frail individuals and fallers, supporting the utility of this clustering for identifying at-risk subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 该研究通过物理表现测量（PPMs）聚类，将老年人有效分层为高、中、低身体表现组，发现肌力（muscular power）和关节力矩（joint moments）是区分这些组的最具判别力的特征。这提示您在评估老年患者时，应更重视肌力和关节力矩的测量，以早期识别衰弱和跌倒风险，指导精准康复干预。
items.titleZh: 老年人身体表现聚类作为衰弱、跌倒风险和认知健康标志物
items.summaryZh: 一项针对368名老年人的非监督分类研究识别出三种身体表现聚类（高、中、低），这些聚类在大多数身体表现测量指标上，特别是肌肉力量和关节力矩方面存在显著差异。低身体表现组包含更多衰弱个体和跌倒者，支持该聚类方法在识别高风险亚组中的效用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study effectively stratified older adults into high, moderate, and low physical performance groups using physical performance measure (PPM) clustering, finding that muscular power and joint moments were the most discriminative features. This suggests that when assessing older patients, you should prioritize measuring muscular power and joint moments to identify frailty and fall risk early, guiding precise rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，不能建立因果关系，且记忆抱怨在各组间无显著差异，提示该聚类方法在认知健康方面的区分度有限。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, and the lack of significant differences in memory complaints across groups suggests limited discriminative power for cognitive health.

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 97 adolescent patients found that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 was associated with an increased likelihood of successful return to sport (OR, 3.56; 95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033) after patellar stabilization surgery, independent of sex or injury characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 该研究证实，青少年髌骨稳定手术后，ACL-RSI 量表得分 ≥59.2 是成功重返运动的独立预测因子。这提示您在评估青少年患者重返运动准备情况时，应将心理准备度纳入考量，并可将 ACL-RSI 量表作为重要工具。
items.titleZh: 心理准备度能否预测青少年髌骨稳定手术后成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对97名青少年患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，髌骨稳定手术后ACL-RSI量表得分≥59.2与成功重返运动的可能性增加相关（OR, 3.56; 95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033），且与性别或损伤特征无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirms that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 is an independent predictor of successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescents. This suggests you should include psychological readiness, using the ACL-RSI scale, in your assessment of adolescent patients' readiness to return to sport.

items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) found conservative interventions were associated with significant reductions in pain (SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%) and disability (SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%) in degenerative cervical spine disease, with acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showing benefit, but manual therapy showing no significant pooled benefit. The certainty of evidence was low.
items.curatedReason: 保守治疗对退行性颈椎病有帮助，可以缓解疼痛和改善功能，尤其是针灸和运动。但请注意，手法治疗没有显著的汇总效益，而且总体证据确定性很低。向患者解释时，要如实说明证据的局限性，别夸大疗效。
items.titleZh: 保守干预对退行性颈椎病疼痛和功能障碍的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入18项随机对照试验（2378名参与者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，保守干预与退行性颈椎病患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%）和功能障碍（SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%）显著减轻相关。其中针灸和运动干预显示益处，但手法治疗的 pooled 益处不显著。证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Conservative interventions help with degenerative cervical spine disease, alleviating pain and improving function, especially acupuncture and exercise. However, note that manual therapy showed no significant pooled benefit, and overall evidence certainty is low. When explaining to patients, be truthful about the evidence limitations and don't overstate efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的RCT数量有限，保守治疗干预措施异质性高，且证据确定性低（low certainty of evidence），限制了结论的强度和特异性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included RCTs, high heterogeneity of conservative interventions, and low certainty of evidence limit the strength and specificity of the conclusions.

items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals Austrian physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, highlighting their confidence in differential diagnosis and concerns about red-flag screening. This informs you to consider professional training, interprofessional collaboration, and liability when advocating for or participating in direct access models.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10名物理治疗师），结果主要反映受访者的主观感知。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative exploratory study has a small sample size (10 physiotherapists), and its findings primarily reflect the subjective perceptions of the participants.

items.title: Trial holds out promise of life-changing bladder control for paralysed people
items.summary: Interim results from the UK ImPRESS trial for spinal cord injury patients show that an epidural stimulation device, combined with pelvic floor muscle training, suppressed bladder urgency and significantly improved bladder capacity by an average of 100% in five participants.
items.curatedReason: 这项在英国进行的ImPRESS试验中期结果显示，硬膜外刺激装置联合盆底肌训练可显著改善脊髓损伤患者的膀胱控制能力（膀胱容量平均增加100%）。这一进展为脊髓损伤患者提供了新的康复希望，预示着未来有望改变这类患者的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 一项试验为瘫痪患者带来改变生活的膀胱控制希望
items.summaryZh: 英国ImPRESS试验的中期结果显示，对于脊髓损伤患者，硬膜外刺激装置结合盆底肌训练能抑制膀胱急迫感，并使五名参与者的膀胱容量平均增加100%，带来改变生活的希望。
items.curatedReasonEn: Interim results from the UK ImPRESS trial indicate that an epidural stimulation device combined with pelvic floor muscle training significantly improved bladder control in spinal cord injury patients (average 100% increase in bladder capacity). This breakthrough offers new rehabilitation hope for spinal cord injury patients, potentially transforming their quality of life.

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored South African physiotherapists' experiences with self-management for chronic non-specific low back pain (CNLBP). Six themes emerged, emphasizing the biopsychosocial model, diverse exercises, educational programs, socioeconomic factors, and interprofessional care as effective components for CNLBP management.
items.curatedReason: 这份定性研究基于南非同行的经验，提示我们处理慢性非特异性腰痛的自我管理，需要更全面地考虑患者的信念、社会经济背景及多专业协作。别再只盯着运动和教育，生物心理社会模式远不止于此。

items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study, based on the experiences of South African physiotherapists, suggests that managing self-management for chronic non-specific low back pain requires a more holistic consideration of patient beliefs, socioeconomic factors, and interprofessional collaboration. Don't just focus on exercise and education; the biopsychosocial model goes much deeper.

items.title:
Rhythm-centred music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation: a scoping review of mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A scoping review of 63 studies identified rhythm-centered music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation, summarizing their mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment approaches (e.g., sensors, motion capture). Coordination-related tasks were common targets, with rhythm being the most frequently used musical element.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查总结了以节奏为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中的机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估方法。这提示您在设计和实施音乐疗法时，应关注节奏元素，并可结合传感器等技术辅助评估，以提升干预的精准性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 以节奏为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中的应用：机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估的范围审查
items.summaryZh: 一项对63项研究的范围审查发现，以节奏为中心的音乐干预可用于运动协调和康复，并总结了其机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估方法（例如传感器、动作捕捉）。协调相关任务是常见目标，节奏是最常用的音乐元素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review summarizes mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment approaches for rhythm-centered music interventions in motor coordination and rehabilitation. This suggests that when designing and implementing music therapy, you should focus on rhythmic elements and consider incorporating technology-assisted assessments, such as sensors, to enhance the precision and effectiveness of interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围审查，仅提供描述性证据模式，而非治疗效果的明确估计，且研究异质性高，限制了具体临床建议的得出。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, providing only descriptive evidence patterns rather than definitive estimates of therapeutic efficacy, and high study heterogeneity limits the derivation of specific clinical recommendations.
